'''Ōtsuchi Mioya Shrine''' (大土御祖神社, *Ōtsuchi Mioya Jinja*) is a {{ill|Setsumatsusha|en|Setsumatsusha|qid=Q1071160|lt=subordinate shrine (sessha/massha)|1=Setsumatsusha}} of {{ill|Kōtai Jingū|ja|皇大神宮|1=Kōtai Jingū|2=ja|3=皇大神宮|4=zh|5=皇大神宮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōtai Jingū|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōtai Jingū|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (the Inner Shrine of {{ill|Ise Shrine|en|Ise Shrine|qid=Q687168|lt=Ise Grand Shrine|1=Ise Grand Shrine}}). This article also covers '''Uji no Nuki Shrine''' (宇治乃奴鬼神社, *Uji no Nuki Jinja*), which is co-located with Ōtsuchi Mioya Shrine and classified as an associated shrine of the Inner Shrine.
Both shrines were established by {{ill|Yamatohime-no-mikoto|en|Yamatohime-no-mikoto|qid=Q4388732|lt=Yamatohime-no-mikoto|1=Yamatohime-no-mikoto}}<ref name="gk">Gakken Publishing (2013): p.61</ref><ref name="ic13">Ise Bunka-sha (2008): pp.106–107</ref>.
== Overview ==
Located at 2132 Osaki, Kusube-cho, Ise City, Mie Prefecture,<ref name="sk0">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p.260</ref> near {{ill|Isuzu Bridge|ja|五十鈴橋|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Isuzu Bridge|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.<ref name="ic6">Ise Bunka Publishing (2008): p.106</ref> The {{ill|Isuzu River|en|Isuzu River|qid=Q6089522|lt=Isuzu River|1=Isuzu River}} flows to the north of the shrine grounds.<ref name="sk1">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p.261</ref> Deeper into the approach of {{ill|Otsuchi Mioya Shrine & Ujino Nuki Shrine|ja|大土御祖神社・宇治乃奴鬼神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsuchi Mioya Shrine & Ujino Nuki Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, one will find {{ill|Kunitsu Mioya Shrine & Ashidate Shrine|ja|国津御祖神社・葦立弖神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsu Mioya Shrine & Ashidate Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.<ref name="ic7">Ise Bunka Publishing (2008): p.107</ref>
The shrine grounds are known as "Chaya no Mori" (Tea House Forest).<ref name="sk0"/> At the entrance of the shrine grounds, there is a ditch about 1.5 meters wide.<ref name="sk5">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p.265</ref>
The two shrines share the same precinct and have a single {{ill|Shaden (main shrine building)|ja|社殿|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shaden (main shrine building)|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神社建築|1=Shinto architecture|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3080012}} constructed in {{ill|Shinmei-zukuri|en|Shinmei-zukuri|qid=Q930545|lt=Shinmei-zukuri|1=Shinmei-zukuri}} style, facing south and enclosed by a single {{ill|Tamagaki|en|Tamagaki|qid=Q3078312|lt=Tamagaki (sacred fence)|1=Sacred fences}}.<ref name="sk5"/> No {{ill|Saisenbako (offertory box)|ja|賽銭箱|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saisenbako (offertory box)|qid=Q135491444|1=Saisenbako}} is present.
== Otsuchi Mioya Shrine ==
Ranked 10th among the 27 auxiliary shrines (sessha) of the Inner Shrine.<ref>Ujiyamada City Office (1929): pp.9-11</ref> It has close ties with the {{ill|Jingū Shinden (Ise Grand Shrine Rice Field)|ja|神宮神田|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jingū Shinden (Ise Grand Shrine Rice Field)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.<ref name="sk2">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p.262</ref>
The enshrined deities are {{ill|Ōkuninushi|ja|大国玉命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkuninushi|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Mizusasarahiko no Mikoto|ja|水佐々良比古命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizusasarahiko no Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, and {{ill|Mizusasarahime no Mikoto|ja|水佐々良比賣命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizusasarahime no Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.<ref name="gk"/><ref name="ic6"/>
== Ujino Nuki Shrine ==
Ranked 8th among the 16 auxiliary shrines (massha) of the Inner Shrine.<ref>Ujiyamada City Office (1929): pp.13-14</ref> The shrine's old site is marked with a stone pillar.
The enshrined deity is {{ill|Takamina Kami|ja|高水上命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takamina Kami|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, believed to be a deity of irrigation.<ref name="gk"/><ref name="ic13"/>
== History ==
The shrine was established before the 5th year of Enchō (927), as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}.<ref name="ic2">Ise Bunka Publishing (2008): p.22</ref>
== Rituals ==
Rituals such as {{ill|Kinen-sai|en|Kinen-sai|qid=Q118906710|lt=Kinensai (Prayer Festival)|1=Kinensai}} (February), {{ill|Tsukinamisai (Monthly Festival)|ja|月次祭|1=Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinamisai (Monthly Festival)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qq=}} (June, December), {{ill|Kannamesai Festival|en|Kannamesai Festival|qid=Q11255045|lt=Kannamesai (Harvest Festival)|1=Kannamesai Festival}} (October), and {{ill|Niiname-no-Matsuri|en|Niiname-no-Matsuri|qid=Q11501518|lt=Niinamesai (First Fruits Festival)|1=Niiname-no-Matsuri}} (November) are held in front of the shrine.<ref name="sk3">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p.263</ref>
== Flora ==
The approach features large {{ill|Camphora officinarum|en|Camphora officinarum|qid=Q158722|lt=Camphor trees|1=Camphora officinarum}} and other significant trees like {{ill|Cryptomeria|en|Cryptomeria|qid=Q147388|lt=Cryptomeria (sugi)|1=Cryptomeria}} and {{ill|Torreya nucifera|en|Torreya nucifera|qid=Q1373999|lt=Japanese nutmeg-yew (kaya)|1=Torreya nucifera}}.<ref name="ic7"/>
== Access ==
Located near {{ill|Isuzugawa Station|en|Isuzugawa Station|qid=Q6089533|lt=Isuzugawa Station|1=Isuzugawa Station}}:
* Approximately 13 minutes on foot (~1 km).<ref name="sk0"/>
* By {{ill|Ise City Community Bus|ja|伊勢市コミュニティバス|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ise City Community Bus|1=Q11379021|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11379021}}, get off at "Shigō Elementary School" bus stop, 1-minute walk (~150 m).<ref name="sk0"/>
* About 1 minute (~750 m) east from the "Kusube" intersection via {{ill|Mie Prefectural Route 37|ja|三重県道37号鳥羽松阪線|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mie Prefectural Route 37|1=Mie Prefectural Road Route 37|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11357923}}.
